answer.summary: Intel's gross margin fell in FY2024: 40.0% -> 32.7% (-7.4 pts). The evidence points mainly to (1) restructuring and impairment charges increased; (2) depreciation from heavy capital spending rose as a share of revenue; (3) revenue fell, so fixed manufacturing costs were spread over fewer sales (under-absorption).
